items.text: (1/2) Yesterday afternoon, I began experiencing mild, cold-like symptoms. I took a COVID-19 test and the results were positive. I am fully vaccinated and boosted against COVID-19.

Ensuring Iowans can afford insulin is a top priority. But today’s bill raises premiums for over 200 mil Americans & sets a precedent that the govt can set the price of meds. I voted no. Instead, I’m calling for passage of HR19 to lower the cost of insulin & all prescription meds. https://t.co/4b7SVYoRM4

Americans don’t need to prove to the government that they should be allowed to exercise a Constitutional right. I was proud to file an amicus brief asking the Supreme Court to take up this case and am glad the ruling upholds the Second Amendment.

Monitoring the cyber security incident at @CRSCHOOLS. I’ll continue working at the federal level to bolster cyber security & ensure schools, small businesses, hospitals, and other entities can safeguard their systems.

We promise those who serve our country that we will take care of them when they return home. 

The bipartisan PACT Act will help fulfill that promise by ensuring that veterans exposed to toxic hazards can access necessary medical treatment. 

https://t.co/rAXnwYUo6R

Last week, I voted for the bipartisan PACT Act, legislation to ensure that vets who were exposed to toxic chemicals during their service can receive medical treatment. Those who serve our country deserve to know that we will take care of them when they return home.

I joined @DougWagner to discuss the PACT Act, legislation to ensure veterans who were exposed to toxic chemicals during their service can receive medical treatment, as well the Biden Administration’s harmful energy policies. Listen: https://t.co/CoQlJfj4Nd

I’m proud to back the Safe Leave for Victims of Domestic Violence, Sexual Assault, and Stalking Act.

The bipartisan legislation helps ensure victims are able to seek counseling or medical treatment without fear they’ll lose their job or risk their financial stability.

In Iowa, crop insurance covers over 22 million acres and provides over $19.6 billion in protection. I enjoyed meeting with the Crop Insurance and Reinsurance Bureau to discuss the importance of bolstering crop insurance in the upcoming Farm Bill. https://t.co/GwfmS1SVGf

ICYMI: I joined my colleagues in a letter to Speaker Johnson urging timely passage of a strong Farm Bill.

It’s critical the upcoming Farm Bill bolsters crop insurance, promotes farmer-led conservation, and supports our producers who feed & fuel the world. https://t.co/MPn6QtNvkU
